They may be identical in appearance, but this spear's strength is inferior.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 14 |durability = 40 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Ceremonial Trident}} The Ceremonial Trident is a [[Weapon]] modeled after the [[Lightscale Trident]] that belonged to [[Mipha]]. It belongs to the [[Zora Gear]] equipment archetype, a collection of Weapons created by the [[Zora]].{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 173}} Though it is visibly identical, the Ceremonial Trident is weaker and less durable than the original. However, it does have the same power.{{Cite|That {{Color BotW|Red|ceremonial trident}} you're holding... In addition to its combat use, it has the same power as the {{Color BotW|Blue|Lightscale Trident}}.|Trello|BotW}} It is used in the [[Champion Festival]], which was started to honor Mipha.{{Cite|The {{Color BotW|Red|ceremonial trident}} is used in a festival to honor Champion Mipha... The Champion Festival's {{Color BotW|Blue|Lightscale Trident}}... Well, it's a fake.|Trello|BotW}} The Ceremonial Trident is required to complete "[[The Ceremonial Song]]" [[Shrine Quest]]. If [[Link]] speaks to [[Trello]] while the quest is active, he will reveal that he dropped the Ceremonial Trident off the west bridge of Zora's Domain.{{Cite|I planned to have that {{Color BotW|Red|ceremonial trident}} examined by Dento. but on the way there, I dropped it off the bridge.|Trello|BotW}} He decides to abandon it in favor of asking [[Dento]] to make a new one, leaving it for someone else to use.{{Cite|It doesn't really matter. It's a fake, after all... I'll have to ask Dento to make a new one. If someone happens to pick it up, they can just keep it.|Trello|BotW}} Under the bridge, Link can retrieve the Ceremonial Trident with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. Then, if he jumps off the top of the [[Veiled Falls]] and strikes the pedestal at the [[Waterfall]]s' base, [[Dagah Keek Shrine]] will appear.{{Cite|You thrust the spear that Trello dropped into the pedestal hidden in Veiled Falls, causing an ancient shrine to appear.|Adventure Log|BotW}} This completes the Shrine Quest. Link can visit Dento at the [[Hammerhead]] to replace the Ceremonial Trident if it is ever broken.{{Cite|The {{Color BotW|Blue|ceremonial trident}}... I somehow felt it had disappeared from this world. Shall I remake it for you?|Dento|BotW}} He requires a [[Zora Spear]] and five pieces of [[Flint]] in order to craft a new one.{{Cite|In that case, I will need a {{Color BotW|Blue|Zora spear}} and {{Color BotW|Red|five pieces}} of {{Color BotW|Blue|flint}}...|Dento|BotW}} The Ceremonial Trident is made of metal. This means that it will attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s and conduct [[Electricity]]. It sinks if it is dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. However, it can also be picked up using the Magnesis Rune, and it is unable to be burned by [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Spear_049" |Life = 40 |Power = 14 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 5 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 8 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 6 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 9 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 13 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 7 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 14 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.5 |ThrowRotSpeed = 100.0 |SellingPrice = 100 |BuyingPrice = 400 }} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Sidon Weapon }} {{Stub|AoC}} The Ceremonial Trident is primarily used by [[Sidon]]. Unlike [[Mipha]], who wields a single [[Lightscale Trident]], Sidon uses two Ceremonial Tridents in combat. When he arrives in the past, he immediately uses them to protect Mipha from [[Waterblight Ganon]]'s [[Ice]] flail and [[Cryonis]] formations. He continues to use them to help the heroes drive back [[Calamity Ganon]]. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Sidon Artwork.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Artwork of Sidon with two Ceremonial Tridents File:AoC Ceremonial Trident Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for the Ceremonial Trident ==See Also== {{See Also| * Lightscale Trident * Weapon * Zora Gear }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Spears, Tridents, Weapons, Zora Gear |items= BotW, AoC }}
